tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism, but the five pilot rows leave its five parameters underidentified. The available trajectory batch directly addresses that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify five coupled parameters; the archived mechanism calls for at least eight rows.
It does not resolve the coupled trajectory parameters.
The observed coupled transient lag and dependence on initial states favor testing the dynamical mechanism.
